name: Nigel III
description: Nigel III was a planet in Expansion Region situated along the Enarc Run hyperspace route. It had an Imperial presence during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The world's port authority seized the Kazellis-class light freighter Longrunner after its pilot, Duan Zorn, was arrested for stealing the starship and failing to pay docking fees.
